g.text: Decompose → STC-encode → fuse with noisy latent → denoise

g.title: videocomposer latent diffusion denoises video compressed latent space decomposed three families
g.desc: VideoComposer is a latent diffusion model that denoises video in a compressed latent space. Each training video is decomposed into three families of conditions, combined freely.
g.text: Denoises video in a compressed latent space;
each video splits into three condition families.

g.title: sequential conditions motion vectors depth maps masks sketches shared STC-encoder convolutions pooling temporal transformer frames
g.desc: Sequential conditions like motion vectors, depth maps, masks, and sketches all pass through one shared STC-encoder: two convolutions and pooling capture local spatial structure, then a temporal Transformer models change across frames.
g.text: Motion vectors, depth, masks & sketches all enter

g.title: encoded conditions summed concatenated noisy latent text style cross-attention
g.desc: Encoded conditions are summed and concatenated with the noisy latent, while text and style enter through cross-attention.
g.text: Sum & concat with the noisy latent; text + style via cross-attention.

g.title: training runs two stages inference DDIM sampling classifier-free guidance
g.desc: Training runs in two stages, and inference uses DDIM sampling with classifier-free guidance.
g.text: Two-stage training; DDIM sampling + classifier-free guidance.
